- **m3**: `@cache` wrapper now has `.skip` attribute (pointing to `SkipMemoization`) for unified invalidation API with `@memoize`

**Verification:**
- 3 commits on top of `base` (`git log --oneline base..HEAD` shows exactly 3)
- Only `funcy/calc.py` changed (library source file)
- All 195 tests pass (2 skipped, unchanged from baseline)
